messages:
anna: quick sync — following the provenance-gateway rfc, I sketched a lightweight ownership map to make cost attribution easier across edge -> enrich -> query. sharing problems + a proposal.

matt: +1 — can you paste the map here? curious about how you handle late-enrich vs pre-enrich attribution.

anna: gist: we attach three immutable headers at ingress: trace_id, provenance_path (comma list of components), cost_key (tenantID|route|model). idea is to keep cost_key stable even if downstream enrichment adds attrs.

devon: hmm provenance_path as comma list feels brittle for large fanouts. any thought about sampling and size?

anna: good call. plan A: keep path as 1-2 components (eg edge, proxy, enrich) and store full path in async metadata blob referenced by provenance_id. path in header stays short.

leo: that helps. main tradeoff: we add async lookups for a subset of queries (recons, billing) — increases read complexity. but cheaper than inflating every request.

jia: what about late joins? if enrichment runs after sampling and adds tenant hints, we risk misattribution. we need a clear operation: enrich SHOULD NOT mutate cost_key.

matt: +1 to immutable cost_key. For late-join heuristics, maybe a best-effort reclass job that reconciles once enrichment finishes, with clear idempotent rules.

devon: sounds good. another issue: rollbacks/rewrites of cost_key when model routing changes. we need versioned cost_key semantics: cost_key_v and mapping table.

anna: yep plan B includes cost_key_v header and a mapping service that knows how to translate old keys for historical billing. mapping service is read-only for ingest path.

leo: have we considered the metrics side? if we prefer metric tags derived from cost_key, tag cardinality could explode. propose a derived-tag policy: low-cardinality tags for dashboards, high-cardinality for trace-level only.

jia: agree. derive metric labels at aggregation time using mapping service to keep ingest simple.

anna: quick sample header snippet:

```
X-Trace-Id: 01a9b3
X-Provenance: edge,ingress
X-Cost-Key: tenant-42|route=chat|model=gptq-v2
X-Cost-Key-V: 2
X-Provenance-Id: p-8a7c (optional)
```

matt: nice. operational questions: 1) how do we ensure provenance-id -> blob store availability? 2) what SLAs for mapping service?

anna: propose provenance blobs kept for 90d (billing windows), backed by S3 + index in a small Dynamo/kv with 7d TTL for hot lookup. mapping service SLA: 99.9 read, eventual write for migrations.

sre-bot: deploy note: adding X-Provenance header to ingress proxy requires schema bump in ingress-config; patch queued in #infra-deploys.

devon: action items: 1) devon + anna flesh out provenance blob schema, 2) leo + jia draft metric tag derivation policy, 3) matt design mapping service API. will sync next Tue.

anna: thanks — added tasks to the RFC follow-up doc and linked infra ticket. ping me if you want to pair on the blob schema. :seedling:
